CustomField.description: The Lottery_Run_Log__c that removed this application's staff priority. Rolling back that run must explicitly clear this lookup, Staff_Priority_Removed__c, and Staff_Priority_Removal_Order__c before deleting the run log, since a SetNull on delete fires no trigger.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lottery run that removed staff priority from this application.
CustomField.label: Staff Priority Removed Run
